report: The Future of Jobs and Jobs Training
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Jobs training programs succeed at scale
entries.quote: In the next 10 years, do you think we will see the emergence of new educational and training programs that can successfully train large numbers of workers in the skills they will need to perform the jobs of the future?
entries.subject: workforce retraining

notes: One question from a canvassing of eight questions fielded 2016-07-01 to 2016-08-12. The question asks about 'the next decade' / 'the next 10 years' and names no year; target_year 2026 is read from that horizon (the jobs report itself says 'by 2026'). Non-random opt-in canvassing.
